correctness.rationale: Sigma(2^a p^2)=(2^(a+1)-1)(p^2+p+1), and its excess above 2^(a+1)p^2 has sign equal to p<2^(a+1) for odd prime p; equality is impossible by parity. Splitting the exact prime-count formula at 2^(3a+2)=X gives a geometric sum of cutoffs 2^(a+1) and one of sqrt(X/2^a). PNT with geometric-tail uniformity yields A_2(X)=(X^(1/3)/log X)(F(s)+o(1)), F(s)=3*2^(1/3)*s^(-1/3)[2+(1+sqrt(2))*sqrt(s)], s in [1,8). Differentiation gives the stated min/max; a separate direct 200000-bound divisor-excess enumeration matched the cutoff and found 89 abundant members. Finite enumeration does not establish the asymptotic.
